description: This file contains the implementation of the StartedKamonTimer class, which is a Kamon-based implementation of the StartedTimer interface. It manages timing segments, tags, and stop handlers for performance measurement within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.metrics.instruments.timer package.

classes.name: StartedKamonTimer
classes.description: A Kamon-based implementation of the StartedTimer interface, managing timing segments, tags, and stop handlers.

methods.name: fromPreparedTimer
methods.description: Creates a new StartedKamonTimer instance from a PreparedTimer.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of all tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds or updates a single tag.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and returns a StoppedTimer instance.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently running.

methods.name: startNewSegment
methods.description: Starts a new timing segment with a given name.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Registers an OnStopHandler to be called when the timer stops.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: getStartTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the timer was started.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Returns a map of segment names to StartedTimer instances.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Returns a list of registered OnStopHandlers.
